study.title: Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Obesity without Diabetes
study.authors: A. Michael Lincoff et al.; SELECT Trial Investigators
study.design: Multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, event-driven superiority trial
study.condition: Overweight or obesity with established cardiovascular disease and no diabetes

master_study_rows: Multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, event-driven superiority trial
Semaglutide and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Obesity without Diabetes
Overweight or obesity with established cardiovascular disease and no diabetes

eligibility.qualifier: Cardiovascular disease was defined as previous myocardial infarction
Cardiovascular disease was defined as previous stroke
Cardiovascular disease was defined as symptomatic peripheral arterial disease
glycated hemoglobin level of 6.5% or higher measured at screening
treatment with any glucose-lowering medication or GLP-1 receptor agonist within the previous 90 days
New York Heart Association class IV heart failure
could not be enrolled within 60 days after a cardiovascular or neurologic event
planned coronary, carotid, or peripheral revascularization
all the patients provided written informed consent
